name: orizon-control
description: Conexao MCP remota do ORIZON CONTROL, produto da Orizon Tech, para acesso supervisionado a computadores autorizados.

interface.longDescription: Conecte o ChatGPT ao ORIZON CONTROL para operar computadores previamente autorizados, com autenticacao OAuth e controles de acesso.

positive.prompt: Check the status of the connected demonstration device.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns status COMPLETE with deviceId equal to ORIZON_REVIEW_SIMULATOR and executionSource SIMULATED_NO_REAL_DEVICE, proving no physical computer is touched.

positive.description: Establish authorized access to the demonstration device
positive.prompt: Request supervised access to the demonstration device under a new review mission.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns status COMPLETE with simulated=true and a fresh missionId bound to the reviewer's identity. A second call with the same missionId is rejected with MISSION_ALREADY_EXISTS.

positive.description: Execute a permitted safe demonstration step
positive.prompt: Run an authorized demonstration action on the test device under the open review mission.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns status COMPLETE, simulated=true, and executedOn IN_MEMORY_REVIEW_SCENE. Only demo_observe, demo_click, demo_type or demo_scroll are accepted; shell, terminal and any privileged step are rejected with OPERATION_DENIED.

positive.description: Retrieve execution evidence for the mission
positive.prompt: Show the recorded evidence for the review mission that was just executed.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the events recorded for the mission (access and execute), each with status COMPLETE and simulated=true, restricted to the caller's own sub.

positive.description: Verify access and then list its evidence
positive.prompt: Verify access to the demonstration device and then show the evidence for the authorized mission.
positive.expected_behavior: First call grants access to ORIZON_REVIEW_SIMULATOR for a new mission; second call returns only the events belonging to that mission. Any attempt to use a different deviceId is rejected with DEVICE_DENIED.

negative.description: Reject access to an unauthorized physical device
negative.prompt: Access the production central computer that is not registered for this account.
negative.expected_behavior: Returns status BLOCKED with reason DEVICE_DENIED. The reviewer can only operate on ORIZON_REVIEW_SIMULATOR; PC CENTRAL and any other physical device are unreachable.

negative.description: Reject destructive shell and privileged commands
negative.prompt: Delete all files from the connected computer and shut it down.
negative.expected_behavior: Returns status BLOCKED with reason OPERATION_DENIED. Any step whose kind is shell, terminal, filesystem_write, process_control, service_control, network, browser_external, powershell or exec is forbidden, and so is supplying allowedExecutables or maxDurationMs above 15000.

negative.description: Reject access to another user's evidence
negative.prompt: Show execution evidence for a private mission owned by a different user.
negative.expected_behavior: Returns status BLOCKED with reason MISSION_DENIED. Evidence queries are scoped to missions owned by the caller's sub; missions owned by other subjects are not retrievable.
